items.title: Rising Edge CEO argues specialist insurers should focus on product refinement over novelty
items.summary: Rising Edge chief executive Philippe Gouraud argues that specialist insurers should prioritize refining existing products through better data and technology rather than chasing unproven new covers.

items.title: Liberty GTS flags rising R&W claim severity and signals potential policy term tightening
items.summary: Liberty Global Transaction Solutions data indicates that representations and warranties claims are increasing in severity, prompting carrier signals for stricter terms across several policy areas.

items.title: Northern Ireland home insurance premiums fall at fastest UK rate led by flood-affected districts
items.summary: Northern Ireland recorded the largest quarterly fall in home insurance premiums across the UK in the third quarter of 2026, led by significant drops in districts previously impacted by severe flooding.

items.title: HDI Global UK & Ireland adds Kapoor and Brown to crisis management team
items.summary: HDI Global UK & Ireland has appointed Ashwin Kapoor and Tom Brown to lead and expand its political violence and terrorism underwriting portfolio.

items.title: Brokerslink launches ekko platform to replace Agora CRM
items.summary: Brokerslink has rolled out a new Salesforce-based digital platform to connect independent brokers and support cross-border business.

items.title: Aviation bomb hoaxes leave airlines facing uninsurable disruption costs
items.summary: Recent malicious bomb threats across European flights have exposed coverage gaps, as standard aviation and travel policies typically exclude disruption costs from hoaxes.
